description_en: Updates an application entry in the service list to support application-specific statistics
description_zh: 修改分应用统计服务列表中的应用条目
kebab_example: aliyun iotcc update-service-entry-attribute --service-id c910061f-0000-44e6-b659-000c --iot-cloud-connector-id iotcc-bp1odcab8tmno0hdq0000 --service-entry-id fwd-119smw5tkasdf0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateServiceEntryAttribute

parameters.help_en: The ID of the service for application-specific statistics. The system generates this ID, and it is globally unique
parameters.help_zh: 系统为分应用统计服务生成的ID，全网唯一
parameters.name: service_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Cloud Connector instance
parameters.name: iot_cloud_connector_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the application entry
parameters.name: service_entry_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the application entry.

The name must be 2 to 128 characters long. It must start with an uppercase or lowercase letter or a Chinese character, and can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh:
应用条目的名称。

长度为2~128个英文或中文字符，开头必须为大小写英文字母或中文，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）
parameters.name: service_entry_name

parameters.help_en:
The description of the application entry.

The description must be 2 to 256 characters long. It must start with an uppercase or lowercase letter or a Chinese character, and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
应用条目的描述。

长度为2~256个字符，开头必须为大小写英文字母或中文，但不能为`http://`或`https://`
parameters.name: service_entry_description

parameters.help_en:
The client token to ensure the idempotence of the request.

A client-generated token that is unique for different requests. The token can be up to 64 ASCII characters long.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the RequestId of the request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: Sends a check request without modifying the application entry. The system checks for required parameters, the request format, and service limits. If the request fails the check, an error is returned. If the request passes the check, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.

false (default): Sends a normal request. After the request passes the check, the system returns an HTTP 2xx status code and modifies the application entry
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会修改应用条目。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接修改应用条目
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region where the application entry is located.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/313836.html operation to obtain the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
应用条目所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/313836.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id
